trust_decision.summary: Tenant membership is decided by the authz middleware only when the populator has put a 'tenant' resource in the context. Which resources get populated comes from the route's OpenAPI x-resources list. The durable-task event-log route declared only 'durable-task', so the tenant was never populated and any authenticated cookie or exchange-token user could read another tenant's durable event log by task id.

landing_point.why: The summary names the durable task event log list. This handler takes the task from the context and queries by task.TenantID with no tenant check, so an engineer would add the check here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: same route; x-resources becomes [tenant, durable-task], which drives the populator and authz
every route whose x-resources lists a parent and a child (populator parent/child mismatch); now returns 403 instead of a generic error
same route; regenerated server wrapper, router registration and embedded swagger spec

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is no O2 site or O8 route. The only thing to dismiss is the populator status code (populator.go:174-176 already rejects a parent/child mismatch, and the fix only changes the error to 403), and that change is cosmetic.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Tenant members must still read their own durable task's event log. Other routes that declare [tenant, task] and derive the tenant from the child's ParentID (for example GET /api/v1/stable/tasks/{task}) must keep working. A fix that rejects every route without a tenant in the URL, or a hard-coded check in the handler, could break these routes or the frontend caller.
